entities.description: An older woman with short, curly blonde hair is shown in profile, smiling gently while embracing a shirtless young man. She wears a black sleeveless top, a delicate necklace, and a ring on her left hand, which rests on the man's chest.

attributes.skin: fair, showing age spots and wrinkles

entities.description: A shirtless young man with curly light brown hair stands in the center, flanked by two women who are embracing him; he has a gentle, closed-mouth smile and his eyes are looking down, while the woman on the left wears a red polka-dot top and the woman on the right wears a black tank top.
